description: This file implements the KeyGraphFeaturesInfo class, which provides methods to convert data structures and create instances representing features of graph functions, including analysis results and feature vectors.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesInfo
classes.description: A class encapsulating features and analysis data of graph functions, with methods to convert data structures and instantiate objects based on analysis results.

methods.name: ConvertWStringVector
methods.description: Converts a vector of wide strings (wstring) to an observable vector of Platform strings.

methods.name: ConvertWStringIntMap
methods.description: Converts a map from wide strings to integers into an observable map from Platform strings to Platform strings.

methods.name: Create (with IGraphFunctionAnalysisData)
methods.description: Creates a KeyGraphFeaturesInfo object from analysis data, populating feature properties and logging the analysis.

methods.name: Create (with AnalysisErrorType)
methods.description: Creates a KeyGraphFeaturesInfo object representing an error state, logging the error.
